alwaysShown.question: court_name
alwaysShown.why: The court's name and address in the caption are asked whether or not the filer has a lawyer; the lawyer question is the last of item 1.

alwaysShown.question: int300_language
alwaysShown.why: INT-300 is in the packet only because the filer said they need an interpreter, so item 3's language is asked whenever the form is here. It follows item 3's box only because the box is printed first.

alwaysShown.question: int300_witness_needs_interpreter
alwaysShown.why: Item 4 is asked whatever language item 3 named; it follows the town-of-origin question only because that is the last thing item 3 asks.

alwaysShown.question: int300_witness_language
alwaysShown.why: Item 4b, the witness's language, is asked whether or not item 4a's date is set; it follows the date only because 4a is printed first.

autofilledFields.why: The date beside the signature at the foot of page 1 has one correct answer and the form already knows it.
